name: claude-x-jev
description: Fast, cheap, typed decisions for Claude Code. Jev (TypeSafe's decision model on OpenRouter) sorts, checks, scores, gates and verifies at 0.3s and a fraction of a cent per item, with a confidence number on every answer. Claude keeps the reading, writing and judgment. 13 commands, 6 presets, one zero-dependency script, a PreToolUse gate hook.
author: Charles J Dove (https://www.charlieautomates.com/)

scripts.test: node bin/claude-x-jev.js --version && python3 -c "import ast; ast.parse(open('skill/scripts/jev.py').read())" && python3 skill/scripts/jev.py lint --preset skill/presets/email-triage.json && echo OK
